reason: This changes BlobOptions from standard IOptions<T> DI pattern to the module's custom IAsyncConfigureOptions/IAsyncOptions system, altering how/when the options are resolved and configured (async, per-tenant lifecycle) which could break other code or extensions depending on the old IOptions<BlobOptions> registration or synchronous configuration timing.
